items.hook: Chang'e 1, the first satellite in the Chinese Lunar Exploration Program, is launched from Xichang Satellite Launch Center.

items.hook: The first transcontinental telegraph line across the United States is completed.
items.body: The first transcontinental telegraph was a line that connected the existing telegraph network in the eastern United States to a small network in California, by means of a link between Omaha, Nebraska, and Carson City, Nevada, via Salt Lake City. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.body: USS Tang was a Balao-class submarine of World War II, the first ship of the United States Navy to bear the name Tang. The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.hook: Normanton incident: As the British merchant vessel Normanton sinks off the coast of Japan, her European officers appear to commandeer the ship's lifeboats for themselves, leaving her Asian crew and passengers to die and conjuring significant political outrage in Japan.
items.body: The Normanton incident was a series of events surrounding the sinking of the British merchantman Normanton of the coast of Japan's Wakayama Prefecture on 24 October 1886. One of those things you can't un-know.
